\begin{center}
{\sffamily\bfseries\normalsize\color{HeaderGray}WEEK 1 INDEPENDENT EXERCISE}\par
\vspace{0.12em}
{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{23}{25}\selectfont\color{CourseBlue}GitHub Workflow Practice}\par
\vspace{0.15em}
{\itshape\normalsize Estimated time: 20-25 minutes}\par
\vspace{0.08em}
{\color{CourseRule}\rule{\textwidth}{1.2pt}}
\end{center}

\begin{tcolorbox}[colback=CourseLightBlue,colframe=CourseLightBlue,boxrule=0pt,arc=0pt,left=8pt,right=8pt,top=5pt,bottom=5pt]
{\color{CourseBlue}\bfseries Goal:} Complete the full GitHub workflow independently: copy the template file, edit it, review your changes, commit, push, and verify changes on GitHub.
\end{tcolorbox}

\sectiontitle{Before you begin}

\checkboxline{Open the course-hub Rproject and pull the latest instructor updates.}
\checkboxline{Locate the Week 1 exercise file in course-hub/week-01/exercises/.}
\checkboxline{Confirm that your personal tutorials-exercises repository is beside course-hub, not inside it.}

\sectiontitle{Part 1. Complete the workflow}

\stepbox{1}{{\color{CourseBlue}\bfseries Copy the template file.} Copy the content of the exercise-01.R file (or copy the file itself) into tutorials-exercises/week-01/exercises/. Do not complete or save your work in course-hub.}

\stepbox{2}{{\color{CourseBlue}\bfseries Open the correct Rproject.} Open tutorials-exercises.Rproj and confirm that tutorials-exercises appears as the active project in the upper-left corner of RStudio.}

\stepbox{3}{{\color{CourseBlue}\bfseries Complete the R script.} Replace the placeholder text, run the code, and make sure the introduction object prints correctly.}

\begin{lstlisting}[language=R]
# Week 1: GitHub workflow practice

# 1. In your own words, explain the difference between:
#    a. clone and pull
#    b. commit and push

# Write your answers below.

# 2. Create two R objects.
student_name <- "replace this with your name"
favorite_number <- "replace this with the number"

# 3. Use the objects to create a sentence.
introduction <- paste(
  "My name is",
  student_name,
  "and my favorite number is",
  favorite_number
)

introduction
\end{lstlisting}

\stepbox{4}{{\color{CourseBlue}\bfseries Review your changes.} Save the file. In the Git pane, stage the file, click Diff, and confirm that you changed only the intended file.}

\stepbox{5}{{\color{CourseBlue}\bfseries Commit the file.} Use an informative commit message, such as: complete Week 1 GitHub exercise.}

\stepbox{6}{{\color{CourseBlue}\bfseries Push and verify.} Push the commit, open your tutorials-exercises repository in a browser, refresh the page, and confirm that the file and latest commit appear online.}

\newpage

\sectiontitle{Part 2. Make a second commit}

Open \texttt{exercise-01.R} and add the following reflection at the bottom of the file:

\begin{lstlisting}[language=R]
# Name one part of the GitHub workflow and how it fits into the bigger picture:
\end{lstlisting}

Write your answer below the comment. Then repeat the complete workflow:

\vspace{0.15em}
\noindent\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{*{6}{>{\centering\arraybackslash}X}}
\textbf{Save} & \textbf{Review} & \textbf{Stage} & \textbf{Commit} & \textbf{Push} & \textbf{Verify} \\
\end{tabularx}
\vspace{0.15em}

Use this commit message: \texttt{add GitHub workflow reflection}

\par\vspace{0.4cm}

\sectiontitle{Part 3. Troubleshooting challenge}

Identify the most likely missing or incorrect step for each scenario.

\par\vspace{0.2cm}

\textbf{A.} My file is saved in RStudio, but it does not appear on GitHub.

\vspace{0.20in}

\textbf{B.} I made a commit, but GitHub still shows the older version of the file.

\vspace{0.20in}

\textbf{C.} I opened RStudio and cannot find the Week 1 exercise.

\vspace{0.20in}

\textbf{D.} I pulled \texttt{course-hub}, but the instructor's new file is not visible.

\vspace{0.20in}

\sectiontitle{Completion checklist for exercises-01}

\begin{enumerate}
  \item The exercise file is in
  \texttt{tutorials-exercises/week-01/exercises/}.

  \item I edited and ran the R code in the
  \texttt{tutorials-exercises} project.

  \item I reviewed the Diff before committing.

  \item I created two informative commits.

  \item I pushed both commits to GitHub.

  \item I verified the file and commit history in the remote repository.
\end{enumerate}

\vspace{0.35em}

\begin{tcolorbox}[colback=CourseLightBlue,colframe=CourseLightBlue,boxrule=0pt,arc=0pt,left=9pt,right=9pt,top=7pt,bottom=7pt]
\textbf{Remember:} A saved file is not necessarily committed, and a committed file is not necessarily pushed.
\end{tcolorbox}
